title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast Fresh Prefilled Pod & Refill  – Fresh Mint
description: Enjoy a crisp, clean experience with the Fresh Mint Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack, fully compatible with all Vaporesso Dojo Blast kits. Incorporating the patented INSTA-JUICED system, the 20mg nicotine salt is securely stored away from the coil until the moment of assembly, providing unparalleled flavour purity. Fresh Mint delivers a straightforward, brisk cooling sensation with subtle, botanical Mint notes. It ensures a purely refreshing and palate-cleansing vape from start to finish, perfect for those seeking an alternative to intense fruit profiles. Each pod and refill pack is fully compatible with all Dojo Blast kits, offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack. Powered by an advanced COREX BLAST dual-mesh coil, it guarantees consistently dense vapour and exceptional flavour reproduction. How to Set Up Your Dojo Blast Fresh Pod: Remove the 2ml pod and the 10ml refill container from the packaging. Remove the red silicone plug from the top of the 2ml empty pod. Slide the 10ml refill container securely into the 2ml pod to assemble the pack. Wait for exactly five minutes to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the coil. Insert the assembled pack into your Dojo Blast device and inhale to vape. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
